from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class RightOfUseAsset(BaseModel):
    """The right-of-use asset value disclosed in a company's financial statement."""
    value: float | None = Field(description="The reported value, or None if not disclosed")
    line_label: str | None = Field(description="The line-item label as written in the report")
    unit: str | None = Field(description="The unit scale, e.g. 'yuan', 'thousands', 'millions'")
    position: str | None = Field(description="Where in the statement this appears, e.g. 'non-current assets'")
    quote: str | None = Field(description="Verbatim text containing the value")

class CompanyFiling(BaseModel):
    """Information extracted from one company's financial report."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The company name in the report")
    security_code: str | None = Field(description="The stock/ securities code")
    report_type: str | None = Field(description="Type of report, e.g. '2024年第一季度财务报告'")
    right_of_use_assets: list[RightOfUseAsset] = Field(description="All right-of-use asset entries in this report")
    period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period covered")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    filings: list[CompanyFiling]
